title.narrative: Transforming Education in South Sudan: Improving equitable access and learning outcomes for children - Global Partnership for Education (GPE), System Capacity Grant (SCG) 2025-2028

description.narrative: The GPE funded project aims to improve learning outcomes in a more inclusive and equitable basic education in South Sudan, identified as a priority reform in the Partnership Compact (2024). This priority reform is implemented in a context where nearly all pre-primary school aged children and 60 per cent of the primary and secondary school-aged children are out of school and where public expenditure on education remains critically low, and where the quality of education is hampered by an acute shortage of qualified teachers (Education Sector Analysis, ESA 2023). UNESCO will implement SCG of the GPE project focusing on: Strengthened system for service delivery, evidence generation and coordination of general education, ongoing PFM reforms; data and evidence on learning and equity and improved national capacities to institutionalize learning outcomes assessments and EMIS data including comprehensive sector reviews.
